headlines.title: ConocoPhillips Names Andy O’Brien CEO as Ryan Lance Steps Down
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips has named longtime executive Andy O’Brien as its next chief executive as Ryan Lance moves to an executive chairman role.

headlines.title: ConocoPhillips Stock Rises as Profit Doubles Before CEO Handover
headlines.summary: Higher realized energy prices strengthened cash generation as ConocoPhillips prepared for its first chief-executive change in 14 years.

headlines.title: ConocoPhillips Beats Q2 Earnings & Revenues Estimates on Higher Prices
headlines.summary: COP surpasses Q2 earnings and revenues estimates as higher commodity prices drive earnings growth despite lower production and reaffirmed guidance.

headlines.title: Small caps are quietly outperforming the S&P 500 and 'Magnificent 7' this year: AlphaCheck
headlines.summary: The Russell 2000 index touched a record high on Wednesday, surpassing the 3,000 level for the first time. And the small-cap index's 20.7% return has outperformed the S&P 500's 12.8% gain this year.

headlines.title: ConocoPhillips beats second-quarter earnings as record Permian production supports results
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips (NYSE:COP) reported stronger-than-expected second-quarter earnings on Thursday, driven by higher realised oil prices and record production from its Permian Basin operations. Shares edged higher in pre-market trading, although the company left its full-year guidance unchanged.

description: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports, and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and natural gas liquids. It operates in five segments: Alaska; Lower 48; Canada; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; and Asia Pacific. The company's portfolio includes unconventional plays in North America; conventional assets in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia; global LNG developments; oil sands assets in Canada; and an inventory of global exploration prospects. It serves in the United States, Canada, China, Equatorial Guinea, Libya, Malaysia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
